question: Under O. Reg. 129/04, can an operator-in-training be designated as the overall responsible operator of a wastewater facility?
options: No. An operator-in-training cannot be designated as overall responsible operator.
Yes, for up to 15 days in any 12-month period when supervised by a certified operator.
Yes, for any Class I facility when another operator can be contacted by telephone.
Yes, whenever the facility owner gives written authorization to the operator-in-training.
explanation: O. Reg. 129/04 requires an overall responsible operator to hold an applicable licence of the same or a higher class than the facility. The regulation specifically states that an operator-in-training cannot be designated as an overall responsible operator.
sourceTitle: Ontario Regulation 129/04 — Licensing of Sewage Works Operators
sourceReference: Section 15(1) requires the overall responsible operator to hold an applicable licence of the same or higher facility class; section 15(3) states that an operator-in-training cannot be designated as overall responsible operator.
